_note: Provisional, hand-set coefficients (not trained). Logs mode is replaced by POST /api/c3/engagement/calibrate once parent questionnaires exist; the camera part is the DAiSEE-trained model in engagementCameraModel.json.

camera_logs._note: Late fusion: the logs features plus cameraLogit, the log-odds from the camera model (engagementCameraModel.json). The intercept puts a typical attentive window (logit about 1.3) where the logs-only mode would be.
